Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoList
Description: AutoList turns retainer Market Board chores into supervised AutoList, AutoRefresh, and AutoTidy workflows with a small in-game tray that lights up when your character is ready to start.
Punchline: Turn retainer listing from market-board chore into one-click momentum.
Changelog:
Added a supervised Move All to Inventory button on the open retainer inventory window.
Added /autolist withdraw, /autolist withdrawall, and /autolist moveall as fallback commands.
The withdrawal workflow scans retainer inventory pages 1-5 and stops if the retainer is empty, character inventory is full, the window closes, or a slot changes unexpectedly.
